# monorepo

Fourteen services under `services/`, one shared library under `libs/platform`.

Almost nothing here is written down. There is no `docs/adr/` and no prose
architecture notes of any kind. What does exist is a stalled first pass:
`docs/architecture/decisions/` holds two `status: proposed` decisions from an
earlier reverse-discovery run that nobody has promoted or discarded since.

So the backlog cap of 20 is not this pass's headroom -- 18 is. The conventions
this repository lives by are real and consistent; they were simply never
recorded, and there are more of them than 18.
